assets.role: 1K PBR texture set (asphalt, brick, concrete, paving stones, metal) for ground/wall surfaces
assets.author: Poly Haven
modifications: 1k jpg maps (diffuse, nor_gl, nor_dx, rough, ao, arm, disp, etc.) per texture, combined into one zip with <asset>/<file> structure. Requested IDs brick_02, concrete_lite_02, paving_stones_08 no longer exist in the Poly Haven catalog (api.polyhaven.com/files/<id> returns 'No asset with id'; old CDN paths also 404). Substituted nearest equivalents: brick_02 -> brick_wall_02, concrete_lite_02 -> concrete_floor_02, paving_stones_08 -> precast_stone_paving. All Poly Haven textures are CC0.
